_readme: Every piece of text ZSB Hub shows. Edit with `npm run text` (live preview) or by hand. {name} is filled in by the app — keep it. **bold** makes text bold. 'where' says where it appears; 'show' tells the text studio how to bring it up.

app.name.where: App name: top bar, window title, tray

app.stage.where: Top bar, under the name (while in beta)

app.testBuild.where: Top bar, under the name, on a test build

header.add.where: Top bar: the white main button

header.report.tip.text: Copy a report for help, see where each account is signed in, and why clicks get refused
header.report.tip.where: Top bar: hover text on Copy report

trouble.report.body.text: A short summary for whoever is helping you: problem codes, counts, and how each account is clicking. The copied report leaves out tokens, names, emails and IPs; the account names below are only on this screen.

trouble.report.waiting.text: {n} waiting for a slot on their IP (CC-RATE-01): not a problem, they start by themselves when one frees up.
trouble.report.waiting.where: Troubleshoot > Report: under the problem list

trouble.report.app.where: Troubleshoot > Report: a problem that is not on one account

trouble.report.one.where: Troubleshoot > Report: how many accounts have the problem

trouble.report.many.where: Troubleshoot > Report: how many accounts have the problem

trouble.report.names.where: Troubleshoot > Report: which accounts have the problem, when there are more than four

trouble.sessions.body.text: Where each account is signed in. A session that isn't this hub can be your own browser — or another clicker using the account, which gets this hub's clicks refused.

trouble.sessions.clean.body.text: Earlier sign-ins this hub made (re-imports, logging in again) that nothing uses any more. Each account stays signed in here.

trouble.sessions.cleaned.where: Pop-up after removing old hub sign-ins

trouble.sessions.waiting.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: account not checked yet

trouble.sessions.onlyHub.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: account with no other sessions

trouble.sessions.failed.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: the site did not answer

trouble.sessions.loggedOut.text: Logged out — sign in again first
trouble.sessions.loggedOut.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: account without a sign-in

trouble.sessions.notFound.text: Couldn't tell which one is this hub
trouble.sessions.notFound.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: the hub's own session isn't in the list

trouble.via.unknown.where: Troubleshoot: an address that is not one of the hub's

trouble.session.since.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: when it signed in

trouble.session.signOut.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: button on a session

trouble.session.signOut.body.text: {what}. If it's your own browser, you'll have to sign in there again.

trouble.session.signedOut.where: Pop-up after signing out a session

trouble.everywhere.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: button on an account

trouble.everywhere.body.text: Every session but this hub's ends — your own browser too, if you're signed in there. This hub keeps clicking.

trouble.everywhere.done.text: {name}: only this hub is signed in now.
trouble.everywhere.done.where: Pop-up after signing out everywhere else

trouble.failed.where: Troubleshoot: a sign-out did not work

trouble.clicks.body.text: Batches the site refused in the last hour, and batches that didn't land. Each one is a minute of clicks lost.

trouble.clicks.ip.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: column (refused with others on the IP)

trouble.clicks.missed.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: column (of the last batches due)

trouble.cause.own.text: Refused on its own — something else may be clicking it. Check Sessions.

trouble.cause.elsewhere.text: Also signed in elsewhere — another clicker is probably using it. Sign it out in Sessions.

trouble.cause.ip.text: Too many at once on this IP — fewer accounts per IP or a proxy helps.

trouble.cause.behind.text: Batches aren't landing — the connection or the site is slow.

trouble.routes.down.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: a connection that is down

trouble.routes.ms.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: how fast a connection answered

trouble.routes.slow.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: a connection that took over 3 seconds

trouble.routes.failed.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: a connection that didn't answer the test

trouble.routes.shared.text: Same IP as {names} — they share one limit
trouble.routes.shared.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: two connections with one exit IP

trouble.session.new.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions: a sign-in that appeared since the last check

header.kpi.clicking.where: Top bar: first chip (a small meter follows it)

income.open.where: Top bar: tooltip on the income chip (click opens the chart)

income.title.where: Income chart window (click the income chip)

income.note.text: Each bar is one hour: the average of the estimate in the top bar while accounts were clicking. Hover a bar for details.

income.empty.text: No history yet — it builds up while accounts are clicking.
income.empty.where: Income chart before any hour is recorded

header.kpi.idle.where: Top bar: shown when some accounts aren't clicking

header.kpi.slot.where: Top bar: accounts over the per-IP limit, which start by themselves

header.unreachable.text: Can't reach the app — is it still running?
header.unreachable.where: Top bar, when the browser panel loses the app

update.ready.where: Top bar, when a new version has downloaded

update.restart.where: Top bar: button next to Update ready

update.restarting.text: Restarting to update — clicking picks up again in a moment.

tabs.count.accounts.where: Tab bar: Accounts count, read out by screen readers only

tabs.count.accounts.one.where: Tab bar: Accounts count, read out by screen readers only

tabs.count.plugins.where: Tab bar: Plugins count, read out by screen readers only

tabs.count.plugins.one.where: Tab bar: Plugins count, read out by screen readers only

tabs.overview.where: Tab bar: totals over every account

overview.empty.text: No accounts yet — add one on the Accounts tab and its totals show up here.

overview.accounts.where: Overview: tile, accounts clicking / all accounts

overview.accounts.look.where: Overview: under the Clicking tile, accounts that need attention

overview.rot.look.where: Overview: 8th tile (takes turns), accounts that need attention

overview.rot.look.some.where: Overview: under Need a look when some do

overview.rot.look.none.where: Overview: under Need a look when none do

overview.rot.ips.where: Overview: 8th tile (takes turns), exit IPs/routes the clicking accounts use

overview.rot.ips.max.where: Overview: under Exit IPs, the per-IP limit

overview.rot.vault.where: Overview: 8th tile (takes turns), combined vault income per hour

overview.rot.tip.text: Takes turns every few seconds; click for the next. Stays on Need a look while an account needs one.
overview.rot.tip.where: Overview: hover text on the 8th tile

overview.accounts.slots.where: Overview: under the Clicking tile, accounts over the per-IP limit

overview.income.where: Overview: tile, combined income per hour

overview.income.value.where: Overview: the Income tile's number, combined income per hour while clicking

overview.money.where: Overview: tile, all accounts' cash added up

overview.tokens.where: Overview: tile, all accounts' tokens added up

overview.networth.where: Overview: tile, all accounts' net worth (as the site counts it) added up

overview.premier.where: Overview: tile, all accounts' Premier ratings added up

overview.pro.where: Overview: tile, accounts with Pro / all

overview.byFolder.where: Overview: heading over the folder totals table

overview.ranks.where: Overview: heading over the count of accounts per rank

overview.rank.unknown.where: Overview: rank of an account that hasn't reported

overview.all.where: Overview: heading over the table of all accounts (click a column to sort)

overview.col.accounts.where: Overview folder table column: clicking / accounts

overview.col.income.where: Overview table column: income per hour

overview.col.membership.where: Overview table column: Pro or not

overview.note.text: From each account's last report, every few minutes. An account that isn't clicking shows what it had when it last reported.

tabs.group.farming.where: Tab bar: drop-down with the plugins that run on the accounts and earn (group farming in their plugin.json: Armory, Games, Opener)

tabs.group.management.where: Tab bar: drop-down with the plugins that claim things and look after the accounts (group management: Missions, Pass, Rewards, Skillmaps, Effects, Armory shop)

tabs.group.trading.where: Tab bar: drop-down with the trading plugins (plugins with group trading: Converter, Trader)

tabs.group.more.where: Tab bar: drop-down with plugins that name no group

status.no-clicks.where: Overview status, for an account set to Off (signed in for plugins, no clicks or vault)

status.needs-you.where: Card status chip, during a Cloudflare check

status.problem.where: Card status chip, when an error code is active

status.reconnecting.where: Card status chip, during a silent re-login

status.waiting.where: Card status chip, while case-clicker.com is under maintenance or no account can reach it

status.proxy-down.where: Card status chip, while the account's proxy isn't working

status.testing.where: Card status chip, while a busy test has the account paused

status.slot.where: Card status chip and Overview status: over the per-IP limit, starts by itself when a place frees up

status.attention.where: Card status chip and Overview status: clicking, but with a heads-up to look at (e.g. CC-AUTH-05/06)

card.menu.busy.text: Busy test (is something else clicking it?)
card.menu.busy.where: Card menu: pause the hub on this account for up to 2 minutes and watch it

card.hero.unit.where: Card: after the big income number

card.hero.stopped.where: Card: big text on a stopped account

card.hero.loggedOut.where: Card: big text on a logged-out account

card.hero.slot.where: Card: big text on an account waiting for a free place on its IP

card.label.stopped.text: Last click {ago} · press Start to carry on

card.label.loggedOut.text: Sign in again and it carries on by itself

card.label.slot.text: Starts by itself when a slot on this IP frees up

card.label.money.where: Card: under the income number (money accounts)

card.label.cases.where: Card: under the income number (case accounts, measured case value)

card.label.casesEst.where: Card: under the income number (case accounts, case value still estimated)

card.next.in.where: Card: countdown to the next batch

card.next.off.where: Card: in place of the next-batch countdown, for an account set to Off

card.label.off.text: no clicks, no vault — on for plugins
card.label.off.where: Card: under the income number, for an account set to Off

card.vault.off.where: Card: in place of the vault bar, for an account set to Off

card.vault.where: Card: vault bar label before the first report

card.vault.tip.where: Card: hover text on the vault bar

card.vault.fill.where: Card: how full the vault is

card.vault.waiting.where: Card: vault before the first report

card.premier.tip.where: Card header: hover text on the Premier rating

card.kv.clicking.where: Card stats box: what it clicks right now

card.type.auto.tip.text: Cases above the case click % in Settings, money otherwise

card.type.off.where: Card: click type switch (no clicks), the stats box, and Select's type switch

card.type.off.tip.text: No clicks and no vault: it stays signed in so plugins can use it. Takes no clicking place on its IP.

card.type.money.where: Card: click type switch, and the stats box

card.type.cases.where: Card: click type switch, and the stats box

card.btn.start.where: Card: main button on a stopped account

card.btn.relogin.where: Card: main button on a logged-out account

card.cf.open.where: Card and banner: button during a Cloudflare check

accounts.limit.text: All {max} slots are in use ({per} per IP). Accounts over that wait and start by themselves when a slot frees up. For more slots, add a proxy in the Proxy manager: each new IP adds {per}.
accounts.limit.where: Above the cards when the limit is reached

accounts.limit.waiting.where: Above the cards, after the limit note: how many accounts are waiting

folders.new.where: Accounts tab: button above the cards

cards.compact.where: Accounts tab: switch to small cards

cards.full.where: Accounts tab: switch back to full cards

cards.search.where: Accounts tab: search box above the cards (from 9 accounts)

cards.filter.label.where: Accounts tab: screen-reader name of the filter buttons beside the search

cards.filter.all.where: Accounts tab: filter button, every account

cards.filter.problems.where: Accounts tab: filter button, accounts that need attention (none right now)

cards.filter.problemsN.where: Accounts tab: filter button, accounts that need attention, with how many

cards.filter.clicking.where: Accounts tab: filter button, accounts that are started

cards.filter.stopped.where: Accounts tab: filter button, accounts that are not started

cards.noMatch.where: Accounts tab: shown when the search or filter hides every card

cards.noMatchHint.text: Try another name or folder, or clear the filter.

cards.clear.where: Accounts tab: button that clears the search and filter

bulk.select.where: Accounts tab: button above the cards that turns on select mode

bulk.label.where: Accounts tab: the select-mode bar (screen readers)

bulk.pick.where: Card: tick box in select mode (screen readers)

bulk.n.where: Select-mode bar: how many accounts are ticked

bulk.allShown.where: Select-mode bar: tick the accounts the search or filter shows

bulk.start.where: Select-mode bar: start the ticked accounts

bulk.stop.where: Select-mode bar: stop the ticked accounts

bulk.folder.where: Select-mode bar: move the ticked accounts

bulk.remove.where: Select-mode bar: remove the ticked accounts (asks first)

bulk.move.title.one.where: Move dialog from select mode, one account

bulk.remove.title.one.where: Remove dialog from select mode, one account

bulk.remove.more.where: Remove dialog from select mode: after the first 12 names

bulk.done.start.where: Toast after Start in select mode

bulk.done.stop.where: Toast after Stop in select mode

bulk.done.type.where: Toast after a click type in select mode

bulk.done.folder.where: Toast after Move to folder in select mode

bulk.done.remove.where: Toast after Remove in select mode

folders.new.toast.text: Folder made — drag accounts into it

folders.newOption.where: Move to folder dialog: last choice

folders.none.where: Heading over the accounts in no folder (only when folders exist); Move to folder choice

folders.count.where: Folder heading: how many accounts and how many are clicking

folders.start.where: Folder heading: start every account in it

folders.stop.where: Folder heading: stop every account in it

folders.remove.body.text: The accounts in it stay — they just move out of the folder.

folders.grip.tip.text: Drag to move (or use the arrow keys)

issue.sessions.where: Card button for CC-AUTH-05 and CC-AUTH-06

busy.btn.where: Card / Troubleshoot > Clicks button: pause the hub on this account and watch for another clicker

busy.tip.text: Stops clicking this account for up to 2 minutes and watches it. If its money, items or vault still change, something else is using it.
busy.tip.where: Tooltip on the busy test button

busy.started.text: Busy test started: clicking paused for up to 2 minutes

busy.running.where: Card box while a busy test runs

busy.running.desc.text: Watching the account for up to 2 minutes. If anything changes while the hub is idle, something else is using it. Clicking picks up again by itself.
busy.running.desc.where: Card box while a busy test runs

busy.left.where: Card bar while a busy test runs

busy.stop.where: Card button while a busy test runs

busy.why.running.text: A busy test is already running on it

busy.why.plugin.text: A plugin is using it right now ({what}) — try again when that ends

busy.why.unhealthy.text: It isn't clicking normally right now — try again in a bit

busy.result.found.text: Busy test: something else used it ({what} in {secs} s)

busy.result.clear.text: Busy test: nothing else in {min} min

busy.result.failed.text: Busy test: the site didn't answer

trouble.extra.found.text: Clicked from somewhere else: +{money} money clicks, +{cases} cases in {min} min
trouble.extra.found.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: the always-on check saw clicks beyond the hub's own

trouble.extra.none.text: No clicks from elsewhere in the last {min} min
trouble.extra.none.where: Troubleshoot > Clicks: the always-on check saw only the hub's clicks

empty.sub.text: You sign in on the real case-clicker page. The app keeps the session — never your password.

empty.step1.text: **Click Add account.** A case-clicker sign-in window opens.

empty.step1.web.text: **Click Add account.** A case-clicker sign-in window opens on the computer running the app.

empty.step2.text: **Sign in like you normally do.** The window closes by itself when it's done.

empty.step3.text: **Set your main account and it starts clicking.** The hub asks once which account you play on yourself. Auto picks cases or money for each account; you can set it yourself on its card.

empty.limit.text: Up to {max} accounts can click at once from one internet connection.

plugins.turnOn.where: Plugins: button on a plugin that's off

plugins.turnOff.where: Plugins: button on a plugin that's on

plugins.settings.where: Plugins: button that opens a plugin's settings

plugins.open.where: Plugins: button on a plugin with its own tab (Converter, Trader) — opens that tab

plugins.section.on.where: Plugins: heading over the plugins that are on

plugins.section.available.where: Plugins: heading over the plugins that are off

plugins.section.more.where: Plugins: heading over plugins on the list that aren't installed

plugins.update.where: Plugins: button when the plugin list has a newer version

plugins.remove.where: Plugins: button on a downloaded plugin (a built-in one goes back to the version inside the app)

plugins.needsApp.text: Needs app {app} or newer — update the app first.
plugins.needsApp.where: Plugins > Get more, under a plugin this app is too old for

plugins.updateNeedsApp.text: Version {version} is out but needs app {app} or newer.
plugins.updateNeedsApp.where: Plugins, under a plugin whose update this app is too old for

plugins.catalog.error.text: Couldn't get the plugin list ({code}). It tries again later.

plugins.err.catalog.text: Couldn't get the plugin list. Check the internet connection and try again.

plugins.err.download.text: The download failed. Try again in a minute.

plugins.err.sha.text: The download didn't match the plugin list, so it wasn't installed. Try again later.

plugins.err.signature.text: Not installed: it isn't signed by the release key.

plugins.err.format.text: Not installed: the download isn't a plugin this app understands.

plugins.err.mincore.text: Not installed: it needs a newer app. Update the app first.

plugins.err.not-found.text: That plugin isn't on the list any more.

plugins.accounts.none.where: Plugins: which accounts it runs on (none — nothing happens until some are picked)

plugins.accounts.all.where: Plugins: which accounts it runs on

plugins.accounts.some.where: Plugins: which accounts it runs on

pluginmodal.done.where: Plugin settings: close button (changes are already saved)

pluginmodal.note.text: Changes save as you make them.

pluginmodal.all.where: Plugin settings: switch above the account list

pluginmodal.selectAll.where: Plugin settings: button over the account list

pluginmodal.clear.where: Plugin settings: button over the account list

tags.more.where: Plugin page: a list of names typed one at a time (e.g. Trader items), the empty box after the chips

tags.remove.where: Plugin page: tooltip on one of the typed names

pluginmodal.search.where: Plugin settings: search box (more than 8 accounts)

pluginmodal.count.where: Plugin settings: under the account list

pluginmodal.countAll.where: Plugin settings: under the account list when All accounts is on

pick.wallet.where: Account pills in plugin settings: line 1 when the page gives none

pluginmodal.clicking.where: Plugin settings: next to an account in the list

pluginmodal.notClicking.where: Plugin settings: next to an account in the list

pluginmodal.detail.tokens.where: Plugin settings: an account's tokens next to its name (e.g. a trade route's senders)

pluginmodal.noAccounts.where: Plugin settings: account list when there are none

pluginmodal.noAccount.where: Plugin settings: an account picker with nothing chosen

pluginmodal.choose.where: Plugin settings: a dropdown with nothing picked yet

pluginmodal.allShort.where: Plugin settings: "all accounts" chip in a list row

pluginmodal.removeRow.where: Plugin settings: removes one row of a list (e.g. a trade route)

pluginmodal.addRow.where: Plugin settings: adds a row to a list

pluginmodal.editRow.where: Plugin tab: opens a folded row (e.g. a trade route)

pluginmodal.doneRow.where: Plugin tab: folds an open row back to its summary

plugintab.tip.where: Plugin tab: label in front of a tip

plugins.state.practice.where: Plugins: state tag, a plugin on in Practice (shows what it would do)

plugins.state.live.where: Plugins: state tag, a plugin on in Live (acts for real)

plugins.none.where: Plugins tab when there are none

plugins.import.desc.text: A zip of one plugin's folder, with plugin.json in it. Signed plugins run like the listed ones; unsigned ones show as unverified. Only import plugins from people you trust: a plugin can use your accounts.

plugins.import.unverified.text: Unsigned plugins also need Settings > Allow unverified plugins.

plugins.import.doneUnverified.text: {name} {version} imported as unverified — it runs only with Settings > Allow unverified plugins on.

plugins.note.text: Plugins turn on and off without stopping the clicker. They only run on accounts that are clicking.

plugintab.empty.where: A plugin's own tab before it has data

plugintab.failed.title.where: A plugin's own tab when its page failed to load

plugintab.failed.body.text: Its page could not be shown ({code}). Reload usually fixes it; the Log has the details.
plugintab.failed.body.where: A plugin's own tab when its page failed to load

log.emptyFiltered.text: No warnings or errors in the log.
log.emptyFiltered.where: Log tab with 'Problems only' ticked and nothing to show

trouble.sessions.noneHint.text: Add an account and its sign-ins are listed here.
trouble.sessions.noneHint.where: Troubleshoot > Sessions with no accounts, second line

pset.clamped.min.where: Pop-up when a plugin number was typed below its range

pset.clamped.max.where: Pop-up when a plugin number was typed above its range

err.dns.text: Couldn't find the site. Check your internet connection.

err.cert.where: An error from the network, in plain words

err.noPlugin.text: That plugin isn't installed any more.

err.windowClosed.text: The window was closed before it finished.
err.windowClosed.where: An error from the hub, in plain words

settings.jump.where: Settings: the row of section buttons on top (read out by screen readers)

settings.resume.desc.text: Accounts that were clicking when the app closed start again by themselves.

main.set.where: Banner button (CC-MAIN-01) and Settings button while none is set

main.body.text: The account you play on yourself. Pick it if it is in the hub, or paste its user id or profile link.

main.pick.where: Main account dialog: the account list

main.notHere.text: Not in the hub — paste it below
main.notHere.where: Main account dialog: list option when the main isn't one of the hub's accounts

main.paste.placeholder.where: Main account dialog: paste field placeholder

main.saved.where: Toast after saving the main account

main.bad.text: That didn't work — check the id
main.bad.where: Main account dialog, under the fields, when it couldn't be saved

settings.main.is.text: {name}. Trades and transfers suggest it as the receiver.
settings.main.is.where: Settings > Clicking: the main account set

settings.main.none.text: Not set yet — nothing clicks until it is.

settings.main.change.where: Settings > Clicking: change the main account

settings.auto.desc.text: Accounts on Auto click cases when their case click % is above this, money otherwise. It's checked at every report, so accounts switch by themselves as they level up.

settings.auto.bad.text: Type a number from 0 to 100, like 33.34
settings.auto.bad.where: Settings: pop-up when the Auto % is not a number

settings.caseValue.desc.text: Each case account works out what its clicked cases are worth from its own reports (the median of its last 15). Until it has 5, it's estimated at 26% of its max case price — $6.60 at $25. Cards mark that estimate "est.".

settings.maxPerIp.desc.text: The site allows {max} per internet connection (IP). You can set a lower limit.

settings.startMinimized.desc.text: Open hidden; click the tray icon to show the panel.

settings.startWithSystem.desc.text: Open ZSB Hub when you sign in to Windows. Accounts that were clicking pick up again by themselves.

settings.closeToTray.title.text: Keep clicking when the window is closed

settings.closeToTray.desc.text: Closing the window hides it in the tray and clicking carries on; quit from the tray icon. Off: closing the window stops clicking and quits.

settings.cleanOldSignIns.desc.text: Logging in again leaves the old sign-in on the site. The hub removes the ones it made itself; it never touches your browser or anything else.

settings.shareStats.desc.text: About once an hour: how many accounts are clicking, income per hour, error codes and the app version. Never account names, logins or anything that says who you are.

settings.statsPreview.desc.text: The exact report, as it would go right now.

settings.web.title.text: Open this panel from a browser

settings.web.desc.text: Check on it from your phone or another PC at **http://<this machine's IP>:{port}**. Needs a password — use a long one.

settings.tour.desc.text: The short tour from the first time you opened the app.

settings.trouble.desc.text: Copy a report for whoever is helping you, see where each account is signed in, and why clicks get refused.

settings.whatsnew.desc.text: What changed in the last few updates.

settings.update.ready.text: Version {version} is ready — restart to use it.

settings.update.error.text: Couldn't check for updates ({error}). It tries again later.

settings.update.off.text: Updates come with a new installer on this system.
settings.update.off.where: Settings > Help, when updates are off (Linux, or running from source)

settings.testBuilds.desc.text: Updates to new versions before everyone else gets them. They may have bugs. Turning this off keeps the test build until the next normal update.

look.section.where: Settings: section heading for colours and the plugin theme

look.desc.text: Buttons, the picked tab, switches and pop-ups. Custom picks the background, cards and text too (it replaces the Background choice below).

look.accent.custom.where: Settings > Look: pick your own colours

look.reset.where: Settings > Look > Custom: back to the default colours

look.warn.text.text: The text is hard to read on this background.
look.warn.text.where: Settings > Look > Custom: text and background too close

look.warn.accent.text: The accent is hard to see on this background.
look.warn.accent.where: Settings > Look > Custom: accent and background too close

look.graphics.noGpu.text: Simple. No graphics card found, so Fancy is off: without one, its moving background and glows would keep the CPU busy.
look.graphics.noGpu.where: Settings > Look, in place of the Graphics choice, on a computer with no graphics card (e.g. a VPS)

settings.theme.desc.text: How the panel looks. Themes come from plugins; one is used at a time.

tour.sample.name.where: Walkthrough: name on the sample card

tour.1.text.text: It clicks for your case-clicker accounts around the clock — money or cases — and collects their vaults. Here's a quick look at where everything is.

tour.2.text.text: Opens the real case-clicker sign-in. You sign in yourself; the app keeps the session, never your password. Once your main account is set, each account starts clicking as soon as it's added.

tour.3.text.text: After the first sign-in the hub asks which account you play on yourself. Pick it from the list, or paste its user id if it isn't in the hub. Nothing clicks until it's set.

tour.4.text.text: How many accounts are clicking out of the {max} one internet connection allows, and their combined income per hour.

tour.5.text.text: Every account gets a card. The big number is its income per hour — clicks, cases (at their measured value) and vault together.

tour.6.text.text: Next batch counts down to the next 500 clicks. Vault shows how full it is — it's collected automatically at the half-way mark.

tour.7.text.text: Balance and tokens from the site, clicks this run, and the two rates that matter: case click % and money per click.

tour.8.text.text: Auto clicks cases when case click % is above {auto}%, money otherwise, and switches by itself as the account levels. Rename, sign in again or remove an account from the ⋯ menu.

tour.9.text.text: Plugins add features and turn on or off without stopping the clicker (Missions is already on; Rewards and Monthly pass claim on the accounts you choose). Log shows what happened. Settings has the Auto threshold, the browser panel and more.

tour.10.text.text: A card or banner says what's wrong in plain words, with a code like CC-AUTH-01 and the fix. Troubleshoot has a short report to share when asking for help — no names, tokens or addresses in it.

tour.11.text.text: Add your first account, set your main account, and it starts clicking. The app also sends anonymous usage stats (no names or logins): Settings shows exactly what, and turns it off.

error.CC-AUTH-01.fix.text: Click "Sign in again" on the account.

error.CC-AUTH-02.text.text: Sign-in wasn't finished — the window was closed or timed out.

error.CC-AUTH-02.fix.text: Click "Add account" and finish signing in.

error.CC-AUTH-03.text.where: Error CC-AUTH-03 (on the account card, a heads-up)

error.CC-AUTH-03.fix.text: Use "Sign in again" on this account before then — clicking carries on meanwhile.

error.CC-AUTH-05.text.text: Clicks are being refused, and this account is signed in somewhere else too.
error.CC-AUTH-05.text.where: Error CC-AUTH-05 (on the account card, a heads-up)

error.CC-AUTH-05.fix.text: Something else is probably clicking it. Open Sessions and sign out the ones that aren't this hub.

error.CC-AUTH-06.text.text: Signed in from a new place.
error.CC-AUTH-06.text.where: Error CC-AUTH-06 (on the account card, a heads-up)

error.CC-AUTH-06.fix.text: If that was you, nothing to do — opening Sessions clears this. If not, sign that session out there and change the account's password on the site.

error.CC-AUTH-07.text.text: Something else is using this account.
error.CC-AUTH-07.text.where: Error CC-AUTH-07 (on the account card, a heads-up after a busy test)

error.CC-AUTH-07.fix.text: While the hub was paused, the account still changed. Another clicker, a script or someone playing it — open Sessions and sign out what isn't this hub, then test again.

error.CC-AUTH-08.text.text: Same site account as another entry:
error.CC-AUTH-08.text.where: Error CC-AUTH-08 (on the account card; the other entry's name follows)

error.CC-AUTH-08.fix.text: Both would click it and get each other's batches refused, so this entry is stopped. Remove it — the other one keeps clicking.

error.CC-MAIN-01.text.text: Set your main account before anything clicks.

error.CC-MAIN-01.fix.text: Pick it from your accounts, or paste its user id. Clicking starts as soon as it is set.

error.CC-SLOW-01.text.text: Falling behind: clicks aren't landing as often as they should.

error.CC-SLOW-01.fix.text: Usually the site or the connection is slow and it catches up by itself. If it stays, open Troubleshoot → Clicks to see why, or copy the report and send it.

error.CC-CF-01.fix.text: Click "Open check" and tick the box.

error.CC-RATE-01.text.text: No free slot on this IP — waiting for one.

error.CC-RATE-01.fix.text: It starts by itself when a slot frees up. For more slots, add a proxy in the Proxy manager (each new IP adds more), or stop an account.

error.CC-RATE-02.text.text: The site is rate-limiting this account.

error.CC-RATE-02.fix.text: Nothing to do — it retries by itself. If it lasts, run fewer accounts.

error.CC-NET-01.fix.text: Check the internet connection (on a VPS: its DNS).

error.CC-NET-02.text.text: The site is too slow to answer (timeouts).

error.CC-NET-02.fix.text: Nothing to do — it retries by itself.

error.CC-SITE-01.fix.text: Nothing to do — clicking resumes when the site is back.

error.CC-NET-03.text.text: None of the accounts can reach case-clicker.com.

error.CC-NET-03.fix.text: If the site opens in a browser, check this computer's internet connection (on a VPS: its DNS). Clicking picks up by itself once it's back.

error.CC-SITE-02.fix.text: Nothing to do — clicking and plugins pick up again by themselves when the site is back.

error.CC-PROXY-01.text.text: A proxy isn't answering — its accounts are waiting.

error.CC-PROXY-01.fix.text: Check the proxy in Proxy manager. Its accounts start again by themselves once it works (checked every minute).

error.CC-PROXY-02.text.text: A proxy refused its username or password — its accounts are waiting.

error.CC-PROXY-02.fix.text: Fix the proxy's login in Proxy manager.

error.CC-AUTH-04.text.text: An imported account couldn't sign in with its email and password.

error.CC-AUTH-04.fix.text: Check the password (import it again), or click "Sign in again" and sign in yourself.

error.CC-API-01.text.text: The site answered in a way this version doesn't understand.

error.CC-API-01.fix.text: Update the app. If it's already up to date, send the report.

error.CC-PLUG-01.fix.text: Turn it off and on in Plugins, or update it.

error.CC-PLUG-02.fix.text: Turn it off and on in Plugins. If it keeps happening, send the report.

error.CC-PLUG-03.text.text: A plugin needs a newer version of the app.

error.CC-PLUG-04.text.text: A plugin's signature doesn't match — it may have been changed.

error.CC-PLUG-04.fix.text: Reinstall it from the Plugins tab.

installer.welcome.text.text:
ZSB Hub clicks for your case-clicker accounts around the clock and collects their vaults.

- You sign in on the real case-clicker page. ZSB Hub keeps the session, never your password.

- Up to 20 accounts can click at once per internet connection.

- Everything stays on this PC. Accounts, settings and logs are kept in %APPDATA%\ZSB Hub.

Next you choose where to install it and how it starts.
installer.welcome.text.where: Installer: welcome page (rebuild the installer to see it)

installer.options.sub.text: You can change both of these any time in ZSB Hub's Settings.

installer.startup.label.text: Start ZSB Hub when I sign in to Windows

installer.startup.desc.text: It opens in the tray, and accounts that were clicking pick up again by themselves after a restart.

installer.tray.label.text: Keep clicking in the tray when I close the window

installer.tray.desc.text: Closing the window hides it next to the clock and clicking carries on. Quit from the tray icon. If this is off, closing the window stops clicking and quits.

uninstall.deleteData.text:
Also delete your ZSB Hub accounts, saved sign-ins and settings from this PC?

Choose No to keep them for a reinstall.

settings.hookWalk.desc.text: A short walkthrough: one channel each for drops, alerts and the daily report.

hook.drops.desc.text: Favourited drops from the Opener. Its webhook lives on the Opener's page.

hook.alerts.desc.text: What needs you: posts only when something happens.

hook.alerts.problems.desc.text: Logged out, a problem, a check or a proxy down for over a minute, and again when it's fine. Waiting for a slot isn't one.

hook.alerts.plugins.desc.text: A plugin stopped with a reason (out of money, a site error). Not when you stop or turn it off.

hook.alerts.restarts.desc.text: The hub crashed or froze and was started again, or kept failing and was left off.

hook.report.desc.text: Once a day: accounts clicking, income, money, tokens, net worth and what happened since the last one.

hook.walk.intro.text: Give each kind of message its own channel, so you can mute the busy one and keep notifications on for the one that needs you. Suggested:

hook.walk.drops.why.text: favourited drops from the Opener. Busy: mute it if you like.

hook.walk.alerts.why.text: accounts that need a look, plugin runs that stop, restarts. Quiet unless something's wrong: keep notifications on.

hook.walk.report.why.text: one summary a day at a time you pick.

hook.walk.how.text: Making a webhook: in Discord, open the channel's settings (the gear) > Integrations > Webhooks > New Webhook > Copy Webhook URL. Treat it like a password: anyone with it can post in that channel.

hook.walk.alerts.text.text: Make a webhook in #zsb-alerts and paste it here, then pick what it posts.

hook.walk.report.text.text: Make a webhook in #zsb-daily and paste it here, then pick when the report goes (your time). It covers the day before.
